fact: The National Identity Cards (Amendment) Act, 2022 (Act 2 of 2022), in force on its gazette publication of 25 March 2022, amends the National Identity Cards Act 2011, which keeps the National Identity Register and a card carrying fingerprint data in a 2D barcode.
title: National Identity Cards (Amendment) Act, 2022
publisher: Government of Lesotho (Government Gazette Vol. 67 No. 19)
